about: Two evenings of street food along the lakefront — Hyderabadi classics, regional thalis, Irani chai counters and a dessert lane — with live folk and indie music after sunset.
Entry passes cover access only; food is paid at each stall. [Organizer to confirm stall list and payment options.]
